name: final-review
description: Final multi-pass code review workflow for uncommitted, staged, MR, and PR changes.

interface.shortDescription: Final review for uncommitted, staged, MR/PR
interface.longDescription: Final Review packages a final code-review workflow as a local Codex plugin. By default it reviews local uncommitted code and attempts two independent read-only sub-sessions for cross-review when allowed. It also resolves staged, PR, and MR diffs, runs the Codex review perspective plus gstack-review when available, validates findings, fixes true issues, reruns checks, performs impact review, and reports remaining risk. When gstack-review is unavailable, it uses a built-in gstack-style structural fallback and reports that downgrade. When independent subagent authorization is missing, Codex asks once before review; otherwise the workflow falls back to local two-pass review and reports that downgrade.
